Setting theme_color to None creates color element instead of removing it

#### Description

When setting `theme_color` to `None` on a `ColorFormat` object, the code incorrectly creates a new color element before checking if the value is `None`. This results in an unwanted color element being added to the XML structure instead of properly removing the existing color element.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from docx.dml.color import ColorFormat

# Create a ColorFormat instance and set theme_color to None
color_format = ColorFormat(some_element)  # assume some_element is properly initialized
color_format.theme_color = None

# The color element should be removed, but instead a new one is created
print(color_format._element.xml)  # Shows unexpected color element
```

The issue occurs because the setter method creates the color element before checking if the value is `None`, causing the element to persist even when it should be removed.
</issue>
